subject.title: fix(agent-tools): add request timeout to remote media fetches

question: Should image, image-generation, and PDF tools adopt the established 15-minute media ceiling for response-header arrival?
rationale: The implementation is correct, but choosing a fixed deadline intentionally changes behavior for exceptionally slow existing upstreams and therefore requires ownership of that compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Accept the 15-minute ceiling
options.body: Merge the header-only deadline, allowing extremely slow header delivery to terminate rather than remain unbounded.

options.title: Choose another ceiling
options.body: Pause the PR until shared-media owners select and document a different agent-tool response-header deadline.

recommendation.title: Accept the 15-minute ceiling
recommendation.body: Merge the header-only deadline, allowing extremely slow header delivery to terminate rather than remain unbounded.

likelyOwner.reason: He carried and merged the canonical shared timeout implementation and the related 15-minute bounded-media precedent.
